signs.text: A boulder, a rut worn in the floor and a flat plate set in the stone. Whoever lived here once rolled things about. The plate looks as if it wants something heavy.

signs.title: Brown Bears
signs.text: Brown bears once lived in Ireland, and their bones turn up in caves in the Burren. Aillwee has a hollow where a bear hibernated, and the bones of bears were found in it. Bears are long gone from Ireland, though the cave still keeps the story.

signs.title: Winter Sleep
signs.text: A bear in hibernation lives off the fat it stored through autumn and does not eat or drink for months. A dry, quiet cave with a steady temperature is a good place for it. This one stays cool all year, which is better for bears than for visitors.

gates.line: A rock slab blocks the way, with a plate in the floor in front of it.

levers.on: In the old hibernation hollow, among the cave's long memory, you find a bear's heavy jawbone, fossilised and surprisingly handsome.
